turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Consumer health softened slightly and credit normalization continued. We remain well reserved.
Charge-offs increased again and credit provision rose. Delinquency trends worsened modestly. Loan growth was subdued and NIM compressed.
How concerned are you about credit deterioration and delinquency?
Credit deterioration is gradual, not alarming. Delinquency is rising in cards. We increased provisions as a precaution.
